actions.action: Check soil moisture by pushing finger 2-3 cm into soil
Tip bucket to check for drainage hole or standing water
Cut away brown, mushy or smelly roots
Repot into nursery pot with drainage holes in chunky soil/perlite/orchid bark mix, set inside bucket
Water when top 2-3 cm is dry, until it drains, then empty bucket
Trim leaves that are more than half yellow
Keep plant in bright, indirect light

reason: The answer correctly names wet soil and poor drainage as the main cause but treats light only as a brief care tip, not part of the diagnosis; its fix (drainage pot, chunky aroid mix, bright light) matches what the poster did, and none of it is harmful.
